text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of summer training 
camp. Rine Kraft is fired up for the Shuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It suddenly hits you that you haven't 
checked whether Cesario will run in the 
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there was no way she'd skip the 
final leg of the Triple Tiara. Refocusing 
her mindset, Rhein Kraft headed into the 
summer training camp.
